title: Road to the moon
subtitle: 3D modeling of a Monument Valley level
description:
The project consists of the design and modeling of a level inspired by Monument Valley, based on the concept "Road to the Moon". To convey this idea, I took as a reference a scene from the animated series Steven Universe, in which a water tower rises to the moon.

I developed it as the first work of the 3D subject at the university, where we started to learn how to model simple shapes.
